t: These Milwaukee Work Trousers offer exceptional comfort and durability for trade professionals on site. Featuring Freeflex mobility with 4-way stretch fabric in key areas, they ensure a full range of motion, ideal for electricians, plumbers, and builders. Constructed from robust 245 gsm fabric, these black work trousers are suitable for both indoor and outdoor tasks. Storage is comprehensive, including removable, reinforced holster pockets, a diagonally opened side pocket for longer tools, and multiple additional compartments. Cordura-reinforced knee pad pockets with protective flaps keep out dust, while a hammer loop and tool lanyard attachment point enhance safety and accessibility. The leg length can be extended for a custom fit.
b: 2 x Front, 2 x Back, 2 x Side & 2 x Removable Holster Pocket(s)
